# 2 Baruch Chapter 33 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**33:1** And-when-I-[Baruch] had-spoken-all-these-words to-the-people, I-went-away and-I-sat in-the-valley of-Kidron in-a-cave of-the-earth and-I-fasted-there for seven days.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 33 is a single verse — a transitional note marking Baruch's return to fasting in the Kidron valley, preparing for the third fast and vision (chs. 35-46). This mirrors the structure of chs. 9-10 and 21.*
